s='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==2]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
